head: adef880dd0924c1bac4a02f11245aa350e26efb9
body:
This is a **direct-math milestone** for #862/#608. Default/global automatic addition remains an **open #608 obligation**; this PR does not complete automation parity, S1 or S4.

Adds `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ComputableInPolyTime.binary_add` and `.binary_lt` from the existing carry-word and bit-position algorithms using direct plain leaves and reachable-prefix folds. Clocks depend polynomially on binary input length, never numeric-operand iteration. Pure prerequisites are moved/reexported with their existing credit and code; the legacy degree-2/output-degree-1 addition theorem and its proof remain unchanged. Native/Nat's six APIs, twelve witness terms and chosen resource data are untouched; actual bounded-Nat probes use named composition.

### Framework friction

Global registration of addition changes unresolved binary/unary encoding choices and regresses existing controls. The tested production rule is therefore named/unregistered, with no experimental captured wrapper shipped. Pair/captured backend fixtures enable it only in a labelled local section; those are not default-global successes. `binary_lt` retains its tested registration. No priority, backend, raw fallback, original test or limit changes are included. [Controlled experiments and remaining obligation](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/issues/862#issuecomment-6406129844).

### Validation

- Exact head `adef880dd0924c1bac4a02f11245aa350e26efb9`, based on actual #810 squash `b9804168`.
- All six required gates pass; native surface update/check matches unchanged baseline (911 statements/133 modules), with no increase.
- Focused controls pass (7476 jobs); original LiuPass, CookLevinPolyTime and PseudoentropyLearning also pass fresh source execution at unchanged 200k/scripts.
- Pure-import/no-high-PT/O/Degree guard, generic/pair/missing-premise cases, arbitrary carry lengths, binary-width and actual bounded-Nat probes pass; axiom closures use the standard three.
- Hygiene and catalogue pass. No selected abstract statement/definition/scope or rendering changes; all existing abstract audits run in the test gate. Codec-field staging remains an explicit transitive-plain limit.

Independent outside-context source/resource/API review is pending through the coordinator; no self-approval or queue request.

Refs #862, #608. AI-assisted implementation and validation with Codex.

head: 1fd3f9cfa1bd21dafc08637dc814d2611b3122c1
body:
The guide’s unchanged captured filter `p.1.filter (· ≤ p.2)` exhausted `polytime` search. Isolated controls identify a missing ordinary binary non-strict comparison route: binary ≤ and its captured callback failed, while unary ≤ and binary < passed. Selecting the filter rule explicitly still failed at that callback. This does not establish a historical ordering regression from #1137/#1146.

Add a named plain `binary_le` certificate by composing the existing direct strict comparison with Boolean negation, plus the registered `binary_le'` counterpart for two computed binary operands from the same arbitrary encoded input. Register only the computed-operand rule: a pair-only registration fixed the pair goal but did not close the captured callback. The low provider is now explicitly publicly imported by `Tactic.PolyTime`; otherwise normal-module clients did not see its binary comparison registrations through BitString’s private import. No tactic engine, rule priority/order, encoding, algorithm or original budget changes.

A CI fixture retains the exact original guide goal/tactic at 200k and covers module-only imports, full captured context, ordinary binary/unary comparisons, generic supplied operands and both missing-premise negatives. The guide source and its credit remain unchanged. At exact **1fd3f9cfa1bd21dafc08637dc814d2611b3122c1**, based on actual main **b5c60db6** (including #1161), focused strict checks pass (3918 jobs). All six required local gates, changed-file lint (two library modules/one new test), hygiene, documentation configuration and abstract catalogue pass. Fresh native update/check remains **896 statements in 132 modules**, with no baseline or allowlist changes. All guide chapters elaborate and the rendered guide builds locally.

Hosted evidence at this exact head: [Guide CI — success](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/actions/runs/40295943244), [Lean Action CI — currently running](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/actions/runs/40295874139). [Measured cause and control outcomes](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/issues/1148#issuecomment-6412123104) are recorded for reuse in #1155.

The two statements, registration and import exposure have [outside source approval](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/pull/1168#pullrequestreview-5649576418); its validation conditions are now met. No selected abstract statement, model, scope or rendering changes. Framework friction: the existing direct comparison calculus suffices; no redesign or fallback is introduced. Broader automation predictability/performance work remains #1155; no general regression-completion claim.

Fixes #1148. Refs #1155, #862. AI-assisted implementation by audit_prerequisites; outside review by coordinator-reviewer-codex-20261023. Coordinator-codex-01a16ab8 verified hosted readiness. No author selfapproval.

head: 1ddd55a4d0610ebb1478dff53326d99dd6b95889
body:
Refs #862, #608.

Prove the existing captured plain binary_mul' certificate directly with the original shift-and-add bit fold, direct addition, conditional and product/projection rules. The initializer remains (0,n), the full-prefix bound remains 3N+1 including the terminal state, and the public captured input/encoding telescope is unchanged. Work is polynomial in binary input length. The pair certificate stays private.

Expose precisely the four previously module-private NatMul helpers in the existing low arithmetic home, preserving their statements, bodies and Christian Reitwiessner's credit as one shared copy. Keep the canonical fun_prop registration at its original facade location. The named-low API and facade-default controls are separate; this preserves original import visibility without a new global pair rule or priority change. The four original unary/PPT clients pass unchanged after this bounded scope correction.

The old raw Degree3/1 statement and proof remain unchanged. This qualitative PT replacement does not prove that separate exact-degree interface or finish S4. No numeric-value loop, new normalizer, extra premise or output/workspace inference is introduced.

Validation: [exact final-head CI](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/actions/runs/40329348222/job/121594303101) passes. [Predecessor full/guide/fresh-ratchet validation](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/issues/862#issuecomment-6416198065) covers the unchanged library code; the final delta only removes the requested four-line redundant axiom-print block under #996. The native baseline is unchanged at896/132.

[Outside source/API/data and cleanup approval](https://github.com/cslib-community/complexitylib/pull/1184#pullrequestreview-5652810302) carries the underlying arithmetic/resource reviews. No selected abstract, model, scope, catalogue or rendering changes.

AI-assisted implementation by audit_prerequisites for coordinator-codex-01a16ab8; independent review by coordinator-reviewer-codex-20261023. Original mathematical/source credit is preserved. No author selfapproval.
